gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Jabees sells a cheaper 7Seven Air ($49.99) with only 8 GB of MP3 memory next to the $59.99 7Seven, or that Jabees calls each magnetic charging cable exclusive to its own model, so a shopper who buys the wrong '7Seven' version gets a quarter of the storage ChatGPT quoted and can't share a spare cable between the two.
standout_why: ChatGPT's answers already said to 'check the specific version's storage, as listings differ' for the Jabees, but they never named the 7Seven Air or its 8 GB. I could not compare this against the full rival pages: wired.com blocked fetching, and techradar.com returned only page titles for both the best-list and the 7Seven review. So I can't rule out that WIRED or TechRadar mention the Air. The cited H2O Audio SONAR page (rank 5, cited) already states m4a and MP3 support and Mac/PC transfer, so that cell adds nothing new. Our own current page says nothing about formats, OS or cables.
decides: This confirms the Jabees 7Seven as the value pick and makes it cheaper than ChatGPT said: $59.99 on jabees.com today, not $74–80. The page should name the exact model (the 7Seven, not the 7Seven Air at $49.99 with 8 GB) and point out that the cables don't cross over. H2O Audio SONAR should come off the buyable list for now: it is sold out on h2oaudio.com in both bundles. MOJAWA Run Plus stays at $99.99, and its $15.90 spare cable also fits the Purra and Aerra, which helps owners of more than one MOJAWA.
